tasks.label: Configure conan dependencies
tasks.command: conan install . -s build_type=Debug -c 'tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja Multi-Config' -c 'tools.cmake.cmakedeps:new=will_break_next' --build=missing --deployer=runtime_deploy --deployer-folder 'build/Debug' -c tools.system.package_manager:mode=install -c tools.system.package_manager:sudo=True -c 'tools.env:dotenv=True' && conan install . -s build_type=Release -c 'tools.cmake.cmaketoolchain:generator=Ninja Multi-Config' -c 'tools.cmake.cmakedeps:new=will_break_next' --build=missing --deployer=runtime_deploy --deployer-folder 'build/Release' -c tools.system.package_manager:mode=install -c tools.system.package_manager:sudo=True -c 'tools.env:dotenv=True'
